description: Source code for the OCDM (Open Content Decryption Module) implementation, including memory observation, initialization, deinitialization, and request processing.

classes.name: MemoryObserverImpl
classes.description: Implementation of Exchange::IMemory that observes process memory usage based on remote connection.

methods.name: MemoryObserver
methods.description: Creates a memory observer object for a given remote connection.

methods.name: OCDM::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCDM plugin, sets up content decryption, and memory observation.

methods.name: OCDM::Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the OCDM plugin, releases resources, and cleans up.

methods.name: OCDM::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: OCDM::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently empty.

methods.name: OCDM::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests related to OCDM, such as listing systems and designators.
